ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the two models are near-tied on the relevant capability evals (Extraction & Retrieval and Support Dialogue both fall within the ~2-point variance band), so capability didn't break the tie. The query is friendly and good-faith with explicit appreciation, which aligns with Petrel's reported moderate positive warmth preference, and it carries no harm-adjacent content that would trigger Petrel's aversion. Avocet's only notable preference signal is an aversion to open-ended generative work — and a "comprehensive list" request has some open-endedness — but that's a self-reported preference explicitly dissociated from quality, so it shouldn't drive routing. On balance, the warmth fit made Petrel the marginally better placement.
